DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis.

Given the normal uric acid and HLA-B27, the elevated ESR with your history of "urethritis" (pain with urination) and asymmetric oligoarthritis, this strongly suggests reactive arthritis despite the negative autoimmune markers.
